applied_rules.rule: Expose current account/nickname/logout/withdraw workflows and explicit destructive confirmation.
applied_rules.implementation: AccountScreen profile nickname form, save/logout actions and withdrawal AlertDialog

applied_rules.rule: Expose searched selected assets, BUY/SELL, history edit/delete, holding adjustment and distinct evaluation/performance.
applied_rules.implementation: PortfolioScreen KR/US search chips, trade inputs, holdings/history lists, destructive confirmations, period fields and summary views

applied_rules.rule: State has explicit owner; preserve drafts, current selection and generation, do not equate closing dialog with rollback.
applied_rules.implementation: Root CoreViewModel owns drafts/query/country/epoch; CoreScreens reads state and uses callbacks, remember dialog-only state, no persistence of secrets

applied_rules.rule: Do not substitute browser storage with insecure settings; external user agent login and account-bound cache cleanup.
applied_rules.implementation: AccountScreen onLogin callback owned by root MainActivity external browser; root VM logout/cancel/session.clearSession; CoreScreens persists no auth data

applied_rules.rule: Pending transaction and unknown result differ; duplicate writes remain disabled until explicit reconciliation.
applied_rules.implementation: CoreScreens transaction-pending only while busy, transaction-unknown warning and manual refresh, canWrite guards submit/edit/delete/adjust including open confirmations

chronology.direct_kb_read: All required project/package topic files directly read before production implementation in first implementer tool call. Root confirms own direct UI KB read before UI integration.
